notes: Replication source is the updated preprint "No Evidence for the Affective Expectation Model: Replication of Geers and Lassiter (2003)" hosted in the assigned OSF project; project link and Study 1 verified. Original source is the full author-uploaded article HTML. Original analytic n left null: participant composition is printed but no explicit analytic total. Original simple slopes use the full regression residual df = 154; replication slopes use separate condition regressions. Printed replication t statistics in p. 16 Table 1 contain an extra leading 1 in their df notation; p. 14 gives standard t(73), t(92), t(81), used here.
